name: Smart Click Tracker
author: Coresol Studio

sections.description:
Smart Click Tracker is a lightweight WordPress plugin that helps you track and analyze clicks on your website. Whether you want to monitor clicks on specific elements or analyze user behavior, this plugin provides the tools you need to make data-driven decisions.

Key Features

  • Click Tracking: Track clicks on specific elements of your website
  • Detailed Analytics: View comprehensive reports with filters for date ranges
  • Device Breakdown: See how users interact with your site across desktop, mobile, and tablet devices
  • User Tracking: Track both logged-in and anonymous users
  • Export Options: Export your data in CSV format for further analysis

Use Cases

  • Conversion Optimization: Identify which elements get the most clicks
  • UX Improvement: Understand how users interact with your site
  • Content Strategy: See which content elements get the most engagement

Privacy

Smart Click Tracker is designed with privacy in mind:

  • IP address anonymization option
  • Data retention controls

Additional Information

Technical Details

Smart Click Tracker uses a combination of technologies to provide accurate and reliable tracking:

  • Dashboard for all click statistics
  • Add New Click Tracker
  • Analytics Dashboard with all details
  • Setting Page

Performance Considerations

To ensure optimal performance:

  • The tracking script is loaded asynchronously
  • Database queries are optimized with proper indexing

Support

For support requests, feature suggestions, or bug reports, please visit our support forum
sections.installation:
1. Upload the smart-click-tracker folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to ‘Click Tracker’ in your admin menu to configure settings and view analytics

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  3. Click the ‘Upload Plugin’ button
  4. Upload the ZIP file and activate the plugin
sections.faq:
Does this plugin slow down my website?

No, Smart Click Tracker is designed to be lightweight and efficient. The tracking script is optimized for performance and loads asynchronously to avoid impacting page load times.

Is this plugin GDPR compliant?

The plugin includes IP anonymization and data retention controls to help with GDPR compliance. For full compliance, you should include information about this tracking in your privacy policy.

Can I track clicks on dynamic elements?

Yes, the plugin uses event delegation to track clicks on dynamic elements that are added to the page after initial load.

How does the device detection work?

The plugin analyzes the user agent string to determine whether a visitor is using a desktop computer, mobile phone, or tablet device.

Can I export the collected data?

Yes, you can export your event data in CSV format for further analysis in external tools.

Does this work with page builders?

Yes, Smart Click Tracker works with all major page builders including Elementor, Beaver Builder, Divi, and others.
